turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ariana, is it your turn to present on Thursday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want a winter project to help me start seeds earlier next year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A small glass greenhouse would be the dream, but it costs a lot and needs a flat base.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A wooden cold frame is cheap, and I could probably build it myself from old windows.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a polytunnel, which gives tons of space but I'm worried it looks ugly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All set, those are the choices. Help me pick.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cold frame is the easy win, cheap, quick and fine for hardening off seedlings. A greenhouse is lovely and lasts, but it's a bigger project with that base. The polytunnel gives you the most growing room for the money, if you can live with the look.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Moshi, should I say something to him?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A polite word is fine. Something like, this is the quiet carriage, would you mind taking that in the corridor.
